bio.text: Rebecca Cooke, a Democrat and Eau Claire native, won the August 2026 Democratic primary for Wisconsin's 3rd Congressional District, according to the Wisconsin Examiner, and is running for the seat for the third time.
She lost the 2022 Democratic primary to state Sen. Brad Pfaff and, after winning the 2024 Democratic primary, lost the general election to Republican Rep. Derrick Van Orden.

According to Wisconsin Public Radio in 2021, Cooke grew up on a dairy farm, owns a home goods store in Eau Claire, founded a nonprofit grant program for women entrepreneurs, and was appointed by Gov. Tony Evers in 2019 to the Wisconsin Economic Development Corporation board.
